originalTool.description: Send a message to a user, group, private channel or public channel (Bot). See [postMessage](https://api.slack.com/methods/chat.postMessage) or [scheduleMessage](https://api.slack.com/methods/chat.scheduleMessage) docs here

inputParams.paramDescription: The type of channel to send to. User/Direct Message (im), Group (mpim), Private Channel or Public Channel

Select a public or private channel, or a user or group. In order to list a Slack channel, **your bot must be a member of that channel**, and in order to list private channels, your bot must have the `groups:read` scope in the `OAuth & Permissions` settings in Slack for this bot.
Text of the message to send (see Slack's [formatting docs](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting)). This field is usually necessary, unless you're providing only attachments instead.
`true` by default. Pass `false` to disable Slack markup parsing. [See docs here](https://api.slack.com/reference/surfaces/formatting)
Messages can only be scheduled up to 120 days in advance, and cannot be scheduled for the past. The datetime should be in ISO 8601 format. (Example: `2014-01-01T00:00:00Z`)
Defaults to `true`, includes a link to Pipedream at the end of your Slack message.
Customize the username and/or icon of the Bot
Reply to an existing thread
Set the metadata event type and payload
Configure settings for unfurling links and media
